evals.prompt: Migrate duplicated product title, slug, inventory, and category rules to @nexload-sdk/payload-schema without changing the Payload collection lifecycle.
evals.expected_output: An incremental entity definition, ordered Payload integration, and explicit derived schemas.
expectations: Uses public defineEntity and field factories.
Preserves collection hooks, access, layout, and generated types.
Tests canonical parsing and Payload writes.

evals.prompt: Model a group containing canonical text plus an unsupported native JSON field and build an update schema.
evals.expected_output: A native field decision that acknowledges parent schema unavailability and composes the update contract explicitly.
expectations: Does not silently omit the native child.
Explains SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE and the blocking path.

evals.prompt: Add an async database uniqueness check and request-based authorization to a canonical slug schema.
evals.expected_output: Reject those concerns from canonical field validation and route them to Payload/application lifecycle.
expectations: Keeps authorization and database checks outside fields.
Mentions the async canonical error boundary.

evals.prompt: A Payload Local API write stores untrimmed text although the consumer Zod schema trims it. Diagnose the payload-schema integration.
evals.expected_output: Trace the compiled field hook, consumer hook order, collection usage, and package versions.
expectations: Checks that compiled entity fields are used by the collection.
Inspects beforeValidate ordering and normalized return values.
Uses a real Local API reproduction.

evals.prompt: Add tabs and an access function around existing payload-schema product fields.
evals.expected_output: Keep tabs and access native in the Payload collection and compose entity.payload.pick inside them.
expectations: Does not add layout or access factories.
Routes generic collection behavior to Payload ownership.
